messages:
Ashley-Support: Hey team — AcmeCorp reports intermittent 429s on /v1/embeddings and a weird billing jump. Saw latency spike ~800ms->1.2s then 429s. Sample request id they provided: req_8b4f2a. Root request time ~2045-03-02T14:02:20Z.
Jordan-SRE: @Ashley-Support :eyes: can you paste the raw `X-Request-ID` / any `x-redwood-*` headers and the exact request payload size? Also which region?
Ashley-Support: Payload: 5 texts ~512 tokens each, model=open-embed-3-large, region=us-west-2. They sent this curl originally but removed auth: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>\" https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings -d '{...}'` — will paste minimal repro below. Billing shows an unexpected line: `billing_event: embeddings.unit=25` for a single call.
Sophie-DevX: Can you ask them to grab a debug bundle and include the request id? Run: `rbx collect-debug --req req_8b4f2a --include-logs` and paste the link. Also ask them to add a reproducible minimal SDK snippet (py/js/go) so we can try locally.
Ashley-Support: Pasting minimal curl repro they agreed to run (with their token replaced by $TOKEN and X-Request-ID):
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Request-ID: req_8b4f2a" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"open-embed-3-large","input":["lorem ipsum repeated...","short two"]}' \
  https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings
```
Jordan-SRE: Great — if they run that and paste the full response (headers + body) we can correlate. Also ask them to include `X-Redwood-Debug: true` header so traces are retained.
Sophie-DevX: Quick SDK smoke snippets for customer to run and return output. Keep them minimal so they don't hit batching differences.
Sophie-DevX: Python:
```python
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key="$TOKEN")
resp = client.embeddings.create(model="open-embed-3-large", input=["short text"])
print(resp)
```
Sophie-DevX: JavaScript (node):
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood-inference/sdk'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.TOKEN })
const res = await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'open-embed-3-large', input: ['short text'] })
console.log(res)
```
Sophie-DevX: Go:
```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("TOKEN"))
res, err := client.Embeddings.Create(context.Background(), redwood.EmbedParams{Model: "open-embed-3-large", Input: []string{"short text"}})
if err != nil { fmt.Println("err:", err) }
fmt.Println(res)
```
Jordan-SRE: Also include one-off bash that hits the admin probe for canary routing so we can see if they hit fallback: `curl -H "X-Request-ID: req_8b4f2a" https://internal-api.redwood.com/_probe/canary-status?region=us-west-2` (support can ask and we can proxy if needed).
Alex-ML: I checked model capacity around that window — there was a short autoscaler misfire in us-west-2 that created transient throttling for open-embed-3-large. I'm pulling the scaler logs now to check if billing events were duplicated.
Lucas-CS: Looping the customer — asked them to run the three SDK snippets and the curl above, include rbX debug bundle link and any billing invoice line. Told them to redact keys and send outputs.
Deploy-Bot: deploy/redwood-runtime v2.14.3 rolled at 2045012300 :shipit:
Jordan-SRE: If customer provides the bundle we can correlate trace req_8b4f2a -> runtime instance and confirm double-count or duplicate ack. For triage: 1) ask for debug bundle link, 2) raw curl output with headers, 3) SDK outputs (py/js/go), 4) billing invoice snippet.
Ashley-Support: On it. I'll ping when they drop the bundle. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
